        CAST(o.order_total AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS order_total,
        c.customer_segment

        blinkit_orders o

WITH dairy_products AS (
    SELECT
        product_id
    FROM
        blinkit_products
    WHERE
        category = 'Dairy & Breakfast'
),
order_products AS (
    SELECT
        oi.product_id,
        oi.order_id
    FROM
        blinkit_order_items oi
        JOIN dairy_products dp ON oi.product_id = dp.product_id
),
delivery_status_data AS (
    SELECT
        op.product_id,
        CASE
            WHEN dp.delivery_status = 'On Time' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS is_ontime
    FROM
        order_products op
        JOIN blinkit_orders o ON op.order_id = o.order_id -- 确保 op.order_id 正确引用
        JOIN blinkit_delivery_performance dp ON op.order_id = dp.order_id
),
delivery_stats AS (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        SUM(is_ontime) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS ontime_rate
    FROM
        delivery_status_data
    GROUP BY
        product_id
)
SELECT
    product_id
FROM
    delivery_stats
WHERE
    ontime_rate < 0.9

        MIN(delivery_time_minutes) AS min_delivery_time
    FROM

),

        delivery_performance dp

        JOIN blinkit_products p ON op.product_id = p.product_id

WITH inventory_summary AS (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        SUM(CAST(damaged_stock AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS total_damaged,
        SUM(CAST(stock_received AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS total_received
    FROM
        blinkit_inventory
    GROUP BY
        product_id
),
product_damage_ratio AS (
    SELECT
        p.product_id,
        p.category,
        (
            CAST(i.total_damaged AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(i.total_received, 0)
        ) AS "damage_ratio"
    FROM
        inventory_summary i
        JOIN blinkit_products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id
),
category_avg_ratio AS (
    SELECT
        category,
        AVG("damage_ratio") AS "avg_damage_ratio"
    FROM
        product_damage_ratio
    GROUP BY
        category
)
SELECT
    pdr.product_id
FROM
    product_damage_ratio pdr
    JOIN category_avg_ratio car ON pdr.category = car.category
WHERE
    pdr."damage_ratio" > car."avg_damage_ratio"

WITH partner_stats AS (
    -- 计算配送员的总订单数和准时订单数
    SELECT
        delivery_partner_id,
        COUNT(order_id) AS total_orders,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN delivery_status = 'On Time' THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS on_time_orders
    FROM
        blinkit_delivery_performance
    GROUP BY
        delivery_partner_id
),
low_performance_filter AS (
    -- 筛选准时率低于90%的配送员及其异常订单数
    SELECT
        delivery_partner_id,
        (total_orders - on_time_orders) AS abnormal_orders
    FROM
        partner_stats
    WHERE
        (on_time_orders * 100.0) / total_orders < 90
) -- 最终输出配送员ID和异常订单数
SELECT
    delivery_partner_id AS "delivery_partner_id",
    abnormal_orders AS "abnormal_order_count"
FROM
    low_performance_filter

    FROM

    WHERE

        oi.product_id,
        oi.quantity
    FROM
        blinkit_order_items oi
        INNER JOIN cash_orders co ON oi.order_id = co.order_id
),
product_brands AS (
    SELECT
        p.product_id,
        p.brand
    FROM
        blinkit_products p
        INNER JOIN order_products op ON p.product_id = op.product_id
),
brand_sales AS (
    SELECT
        pb.brand,

    FROM

        INNER JOIN order_products op ON pb.product_id = op.product_id
    GROUP BY
        pb.brand
)
SELECT
    bs.brand AS "brand",
    (
        bs.total_quantity / (
            SELECT
                SUM(total_quantity)
            FROM
                brand_sales
        )
    ) AS "sales_ratio"
